option_relations.rationale: Fibrosis and ulceration caused by meperidine are components of the broader diagnosis of Factitial panniculitis (self-induced) secondary to chronic subcutaneous meperidine injections, with associated fibrosis and muscle contractures.

Post-injection granuloma is a specific type of lesion that can occur in the context of Factitial panniculitis (self-induced) secondary to chronic subcutaneous meperidine injections, with associated fibrosis and muscle contractures.

Factitial panniculitis is directly equivalent to the leaf 'Factitial panniculitis (self-induced) secondary to chronic subcutaneous meperidine injections, with associated fibrosis and muscle contractures', as the leaf provides a more detailed description of the same condition.

Meperidine-induced panniculitis is a specific form of panniculitis that is encompassed by the broader diagnosis of Factitial panniculitis (self-induced) secondary to chronic subcutaneous meperidine injections, with associated fibrosis and muscle contractures.
